options.name: write
options.setting-help: the Modbus writes the fake accepts from its clients

options.setting-help: accept Modbus writes (FC05/06/15/16) from clients; off = every write refused

options.help: accept Modbus writes (FC05/06/15/16) from the fake's clients: a write lands in the write overlay, logged and audited WRITE like the cache's forwarded ones; off = every write is refused with exception 01 and audited WRITE-REFUSED — the cache's --allow-write gate, mirrored (env ALLOW_WRITE)

options.name: control-port

options.help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run its policy's verbs only (the default policy: show) (no set/clear, no reset, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited; the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)

options.name: control-socket-group
options.setting-help: leave the unix control socket group-accessible (chmod 0660 instead of the plain 0600): a local group may speak to the control without being the service user
options.help: leave the unix control socket group-accessible (chmod 0660 instead of the plain 0600): a local group may speak to the control wire without the token ($CONTROL_SOCKET_GROUP)
